claims.text: Capital of Queensland, leafy river city built around loops of the Brisbane River
South Bank Parklands, City Botanic Gardens, cultural precinct easy to wander on foot
claims.source: https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Brisbane (South Bank listings; walkability is the drafter's inference)
claims.fix: keep; mild inference, or say 'South Bank Parklands and City Botanic Gardens are central'

claims.text: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary: cuddle a koala
claims.source: https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Brisbane (Lone Pine listing: 'Cuddle a koala', 130+ koalas)

claims.text: Mount Coot-tha looks out over the city
Museums and galleries cover art, history
CityCat and ferry services run along the river
CityCat/ferries are a 'cheap' way to reach South Bank, New Farm
claims.fix: Drop 'cheap' and the named stops: 'CityCat and ferry services run along the river and are a good way to see the city from the water.'

claims.text: go card covers trains, buses, ferries and trams
claims.source: https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Brisbane (touch on/off each mode: trains, trams, buses, ferries)

claims.fix: Remove the claim; page does not state a discount.

claims.text: Best months Apr-Oct, mild dry weather
